intent: Analyze Dell G16 7630 Gaming Laptop System State Baseline
detected_fault: VIDEO_TDR_FAILURE (nvlddmkm.sys) BSOD due to thermal throttling or cooling system malfunction
suggested_solution: Inspect the laptop's cooling system and thermal paste for any signs of wear or damage.
Run additional stress tests, such as Prime95 or Unigine Heaven, to identify potential thermal throttling issues.
Check the PSU unit for any signs of physical damage or excessive wear.
